headline: Beirut rejects US-backed demand for direct military coordination with Israel
dek: Lebanese military delegation meets Israeli and US officials in Tampa on Oct 20 to press for halt to Israeli attacks; Lebanon is rejecting US-backed proposals for direct LAF-IDF military coordination (officials expect limited progress before Israel's elections next week). US/Israel precondition…
sources: Lebanese presidency (X post Saturday), The National (Lebanese political official close to talks), L'Orient-Le Jour (talks precondition), US State Dept spokesperson to Al-Jadeed
fault_line: Is direct military coordination with Israel the only road to Israeli withdrawal, or a capitulation Lebanon must never accept?

sections.what_happened: Lebanese military delegation meets Israeli and US officials in Tampa on Oct 20 to press for halt to Israeli attacks; Lebanon is rejecting US-backed proposals for direct LAF-IDF military coordination (officials expect limited progress before Israel's elections next week). US/Israel precondition (per L'Orient sources): direct coordination between Lebanese and Israeli armies for pilot-zone verification mechanism. US State Dept to Al-Jadeed: June framework provides for 'complete disarmament of Hezbollah throughout Lebanese territory.' Monday: President Aoun took tougher line — ban armed demonstrations, seize illegal weapons, prosecute offenders — after explosives seizure in Dahr al-Baidar. UNIFIL mandate expires end of year; Lebanon seeks international presence to avoid vacuum.
sections.what_verified: Talks date confirmed by Lebanese presidency X post (Saturday), Al Arabiya, Times of Israel; rejection quote from Lebanese political official via The National; precondition via L'Orient-Le Jour; State Dept statement via Al-Jadeed.
sections.what_disputed: Direct-coordination precondition is sourced to L'Orient's reporting and Lebanese officials' characterization — not directly stated by US/Israeli officials on record; label as attributed report. Limited-progress expectations are Lebanese officials' framing.
sections.why_matters: Map-first diplomacy explainer: pilot zones, the Hezbollah-disarmament deadlock, UNIFIL's expiring mandate — the Tampa meeting as the hinge. Keep the precondition attributed.
sections.context: Background: Lebanon-Israel-US trilateral talks in Tampa TODAY: Beirut rejects US-backed demand for direct military coordination with Israel

totw_analysis: Our read: Map-first diplomacy explainer: pilot zones, the Hezbollah-disarmament deadlock, UNIFIL's expiring mandate — the Tampa meeting as the hinge. Keep the precondition attributed. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Is direct military coordination with Israel the only road to Israeli withdrawal, or a capitulation Lebanon must never accept?
